channel.title: Unown blog
channel.description: How each feature and release works, what it does, and the receipts behind it — the longhand record of the self-improving terminal coding agent Unown.

item.title: "The chaos round: orphaned fleets, stolen steering, and the reports that lied"
item.description: "The chaos round: nested CLI calls, watchdog kills, oversized reports, slow children outliving the process. Seven findings, fixed and pinned."

item.title: "The hardening round: the verdict on the detached engine"
item.description: "We re-litigated the core USP's architecture against ten competitor repos and 54 sources. The detached engine stays; six honest-failure lanes ship in v0.0.28."

item.title: "The ledger round: the seams the chaos round wrote down"
item.description: "Round three paid the chaos round's IOUs: the stop that couldn't un-park, the re-ask that vanished, the name with no entropy, the crash with no trace."

item.title: "The orphan round: the lane with no ledger of its own"
item.description: "Round four paid the ledger's last IOU: the sync lane's kill -9 orphans — alive, unrecorded, swept by nobody — now journal, heartbeat, and sweep."

item.title: "The SOTA memory-eval round: four suites, one real fix, and a bill paid"
item.description: "How our memory system earned its numbers: gold-op ledgers, dual-embedder retrieval, a calibrated judge, twelve failure modes — and the bug they caught."

item.title: "The SOTA re-cut: thirteen reels re-filmed, and how we audit demo video"
item.description: "A frame-sampled VLM audit sent thirteen landing reels back into the capture harness — and the first audit pass itself was wrong about what it saw."

item.title: "The stress round: what breaks when a real user drives the browser"
item.description: "Fifteen hostile scenarios and seven competitor repos exposed three browser-agent architecture bugs — all closed in v0.0.29."

item.title: "The subagent stress round: what a real model found that the scripted tests could not"
item.description: "Ten live scenarios drove the subagent stack the way its docs promise — six real defects found, two of them silently broken features, all fixed and pinned."

item.title: The memory that proves itself before it ships
item.description: How Unown turns session notes into four-tier project memory, why the files stay plain markdown, and what the engine verifies before keeping any of it.

item.title: Unown is in beta — here is what that means
item.description: The self-improving terminal coding agent is in beta: what works, what moves, and where to report what breaks while the 0.0.x line grows up.

item.title: v0.0.15 — every capability filmed, the atlas passes review
item.description: The media-completion and sprite-craft round: the dex ships 24 movies on 22 entries with zero pending plates, and the creature atlas passes its review lane.
